title: fix: normalize Nova provider to Bedrock
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Changes `nova-canvas` and `nova-reel` registry providers from `aws` to `bedrock`.
- Aligns Nova media attribution with the existing Claude and Nova text registry entries.
- Leaves Bedrock model IDs, runtime routing, pricing, and paid status unchanged.
- Adds a focused regression test for both media models.

Root cause: the Nova media entries retained the older `aws` label after the text registry standardized on `bedrock`.

Checks:
- `npx biome check --write shared/registry/image.ts enter.pollinations.ai/test/aliases.test.ts`
- `npx vitest run test/aliases.test.ts test/pricing-data.test.ts test/effective-prices.snapshot.test.ts` (298 passed)

gist.headline: Nova finds its proper cloud
gist.blurb: Nova Canvas and Nova Reel have been moved under the Bedrock signpost, where their text-model siblings already live. Same models, same routes, fewer tiny provider-label mysteries.
gist.summary: Normalized the `nova-canvas` and `nova-reel` image registry provider from `aws` to `bedrock`, matching Claude and Nova text entries while preserving model IDs, routing, pricing, and paid status.
gist.impact: Developers now receive consistent `bedrock` provider attribution for Nova media models without changing how Nova Canvas or Nova Reel are accessed or billed.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy cloud-garden registry where two Nova media canvases are relocated from an old wooden sign labeled AWS to a matching Bedrock stone arch, alongside friendly Claude/Nova text scrolls. Polli wears a tiny cloud-engineer cap and carefully updates the sign while code-plants and a retro terminal show the unchanged route and price markers, making the change feel like tidying a label rather than moving the machinery.
